background: Al Rayan Bank is the largest Sharia-compliant bank in the UK, owned by Masraf Al Rayan of Qatar, funded by retail savings and lending mainly on residential and commercial property.
synthesis: Only one of the three main agencies rates the bank, at A on a stable outlook, the last move a one-notch downgrade on 24 May 2024. Capital is the weak spot against UK small banks, with CET1 of 15.4% and leverage of 7.6% both in the bottom quarter. Liquidity is plentiful on the short-term measure, LCR of 481% in the top quarter, though NSFR of 151% is below the peer median. Since 31 Dec 2021 leverage has risen 0.8 points and LCR 124 points, with figures only to 31 Dec 2025.
